implementation_choices.selection: final epoch, no validation/test model selection (user selected)
implementation_choices.scheduler: constant LR; paper does not specify decay
implementation_choices.mse_reduction: mean over samples, joints and XY; no confidence weighting or /32
implementation_choices.coordinates: upstream XY*0.001 for training, pixel metrics; no physical calibration
implementation_choices.metrics: all 18 joints; invalid torso excluded from PCK; PA per pose
implementation_choices.initialization: same inherited HPEWiPoseModel backbone/decoder for both scenarios
implementation_choices.architecture: published repository snapshot, not independently proven identical to ECCV implementation
implementation_choices.TCN: includes pooling change preserving five CSI time samples, not pose frames

limits: author split IDs/seed and validation policy not published in cited description
random frame split is not cross-subject or cross-sequence evaluation
native image labels do not justify reporting physical millimetres
no guarantee of paper table reproduction or improved accuracy
